$commentaire: Briefs de génération audio (ElevenLabs), source unique du laboratoire /audio-lab et de scripts/elevenlabs-generate.mjs. Aucun fichier n'a encore été généré : les candidats iront dans public/music/candidates/ et public/sfx/candidates/, sans jamais écraser les originaux.

directions.label: Douce et mélodique
directions.description: Piano feutré et cordes douces, une mélodie simple qui se répète sans lasser — la lecture « carte postale » d'un jeu de collection.
directions.prompt: Gentle melodic ambient loop for a cozy card-collecting game: felt piano playing a simple, memorable four-bar melody, soft warm strings underneath, a hint of music box, slow and calm around 70 BPM, no drums, no percussion peaks, no vocals, seamless loop, low and even dynamics, pleasant over hours of play.

directions.label: Chaleureuse et accueillante
directions.description: Guitare acoustique et clavier chaud, l'ambiance d'un café tranquille où l'on ouvre ses boosters — conviviale sans être présente.
directions.prompt: Warm welcoming background loop for a friendly trading-card game: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, mellow Rhodes piano chords, soft upright bass, very light brushed percussion kept far in the background, relaxed groove around 85 BPM, no vocals, no solos, seamless loop, even gentle dynamics that never fight the sound effects.

directions.label: Minimaliste, très discrète
directions.description: Nappes espacées et notes rares : à peine un souffle sonore, pour les longues sessions et les joueurs qui veulent presque du silence.
directions.prompt: Extremely discreet minimal ambient loop for long play sessions: very sparse soft synth pads, a single gentle plucked note every few seconds, lots of space and near-silence between sounds, around 60 BPM, no melody hooks, no drums, no vocals, seamless loop, extremely low and flat dynamics, designed to be almost unnoticed.

sons.label: Carte tirée / papier
sons.prompt: A single playing card sliding out of a paper booster pack, soft paper swish, close and dry, no music

sons.label: Carte retournée / page
sons.prompt: A thick trading card flipping over on a table, soft paper snap, warm and short, no music

sons.label: Déchirure du sachet (nouveau)
sons.prompt: Tearing open a foil trading-card booster pack, crinkly foil and paper rip, satisfying but gentle, no music

sons.label: Tampon / carte posée
sons.prompt: A rubber stamp pressing softly onto paper, one warm wooden thud with a tiny resonance, no music

sons.label: Tap d'interface
sons.prompt: Very soft short user-interface tap, rounded and woody, quiet, like touching a polished wooden button, no music

sons.label: Confirmation douce
sons.prompt: Gentle confirmation blip, one warm sine tone with a soft harmonic, pleasant and very short, no music

sons.label: Pop d'ouverture
sons.prompt: Soft bubble pop, round and friendly, like a soap bubble bursting close to the microphone, no music

sons.label: Fermeture / refus doux
sons.prompt: Soft dismissive tap, muted paper closing, low and gentle, not negative, no music

sons.label: Pièces / récompense encaissée
sons.prompt: A few small coins dropping gently into a wooden bowl, warm and sparse, not a casino sound, no music

sons.label: Ouverture de feuille
sons.prompt: Soft paper sheet sliding open, quiet airy whoosh, subtle and short, no music

sons.label: Carillon de récompense
sons.prompt: Warm reward chime, two soft bell tones with natural decay, gentle and premium, no music box harshness, no music

sons.label: Scintillement de révélation (nouveau)
sons.prompt: Delicate magical shimmer for a rare card reveal, soft sparkling harmonics rising gently, luxurious but quiet, no music
